Two remaining gaps where an engineer who is off the VPN or not allow-listed still gets a confusing installer/plugin result. (A) The installer smoke test prints its fixed VPN / allow-list hint only when the anonymous pre-flight fails ('smoke network: fail ...'). When the origin probe passes but the authenticated request then fails for a network reason (a WAF / path rule or a drop on the API path, a proxy), the output is 'smoke network: pass' followed by 'smoke azdo: fail network-unreachable|network-blocked|timeout' or 'smoke bifrost: fail network|timeout|407|470' with NO hint (installer-cli 1.3.1 section 9.1 says these codes do not add the hint). Change formatSmoke so the SAME fixed network hint line (installer-cli section 7, text unchanged) is also printed for those authenticated-line codes, at most once per run. Bifrost 401/403/other statuses stay hint-free (key / permission problems, see troubleshooting 'Bifrost 401'). (B) Azure Firewall answers an application-rule deny (no rule matched; for HTTPS only with TLS inspection) with the non-standard HTTP 470 'Action: Deny' body (community-reported, not in Microsoft docs; relevant when an engineer's egress goes through Azure Firewall, e.g. Azure Virtual Desktop / Dev Box / forced-tunnel VPN). Today the installer probe treats 470 as reachable, so the PAT / az token / virtual key is then SENT, and the result reads 'smoke azdo: fail http-470' / 'smoke bifrost: fail 470' with no hint; the plugin logs 'http-470' with no hint. 470 is not a status Azure DevOps or Bifrost answer, so classifying it as a block has no realistic false positive: classifyProbeStatus(470) -> blocked (credential never sent, network line azdo-blocked / bifrost-blocked); the plugin fetch maps HTTP 470 (any Content-Type, body discarded unread) to network-blocked with the existing NETWORK hint. Out of scope (later items, not this cycle): 203 HTML sign-in (T-034, needs evidence); a plugin-side Bifrost reachability check at Kilo start (Kilo's own runtime model calls to Bifrost are not controlled by the plugin; documented limitation). Constraints: FR-10 never throws; FR-11 one plugin file, zero runtime deps, no new import, __internals key set unchanged; no secret or value in any log or output line; exactly one fetch per plugin hook run (no new probe); cache order (ADR-0008) and T-013 binding unchanged; hint texts unchanged. Contracts: installer-cli minor bump (sections 7 / 9.0 / 9.1: hint rule and 470 verdict), plugin-interface minor bump (470 row), ADR-0019 / ADR-0020 amendments. Docs (docs-writer): troubleshooting / runbook rows for 470 and the new hint behaviour. Versioning: patch (fix of user-facing diagnostics).
acceptance_criteria: Given a smoke report with network pass and azdo 'fail network-unreachable', 'fail network-blocked' or 'fail timeout', When formatSmoke runs, Then the output is the network line, the azdo line, the bifrost line and then exactly one line equal to the existing fixed VPN / allow-list hint (installer-cli section 7 text, unchanged); and Given azdo fails with http-401, http-403, http-404, auth-unavailable, invalid-settings, network or bad-response, Then no network hint line is printed.

Given a smoke report with network pass, azdo pass and bifrost 'fail network', 'fail timeout', 'fail 407' or 'fail 470', When formatSmoke runs, Then exactly one network hint line is printed; and Given bifrost 'fail 401', 'fail 403', 'fail 404', 'fail 500', 'fail bad-response', 'fail invalid-key' or any skipped code, Then no network hint line is printed.

Given a report with both a failed pre-flight (network fail with a non-internal code) and a qualifying authenticated-line code, When formatSmoke runs, Then the network hint appears exactly once and the existing no-key hint behaviour is unchanged; and Given network fail with only 'internal', Then no network hint is printed (unchanged).

Given a fake probe fetch answering HTTP 470 for the Azure DevOps origin (or the Bifrost origin), When runSmoke runs, Then the network line reads 'smoke network: fail azdo-blocked' (or 'bifrost-blocked'), the corresponding check is 'skipped network-blocked', the authenticated fetch / az runner (or the GET models request) is never called so no credential or key is sent, and the installer exits with code 4; and classifyProbeStatus(470) returns 'blocked' while 200, 301, 401 and 404 stay 'reachable'.

Given a fake plugin fetch answering HTTP 470 with any Content-Type (text/plain, text/html, application/json, absent), When fetchRemoteConfig runs, Then it resolves { ok: false, error: 'network-blocked' }, the body's getReader is never called and body.cancel is invoked; and Given the config hook with that failure, Then the unchanged 'Remote config unavailable (network-blocked) ...' line is followed by exactly one NETWORK hint line, the fake fetch was called exactly once, and a valid bound cache is still applied as before.

Given failure responses carrying canary values in body and headers plus PAT / az token / virtual-key canaries, When runSmoke and the config hook run, Then no output or log line contains any credential, URL, host name, org/project/repo value, header value or body text, and neither function throws.

Given the change, When the FR-11 lint and 'bash scripts/ci.sh' run, Then the plugin is still ONE TypeScript file with zero runtime npm dependencies and no new import, the __internals key set is unchanged, existing tests change only where they pinned the old no-hint / http-470 behaviour, and CI exits 0.

items.title: Harden smoke formatLine; hint for Azure DevOps conditional-access IP blocks
items.description: Cycle 0024 security/review follow-ups: (info) backend/installer/smoke.ts formatLine/networkLine read status/code unguarded so a hand-built report with a throwing getter or Symbol code makes formatSmoke throw (no real runSmoke path produces one; install-helper's try/catch keeps exit 4) - guard with attempt and show non-string codes as `internal`; read the network outcome fields once; (needs a contract decision first) a specific hint for Azure DevOps organisation IP conditional-access blocks (JSON 401/403), which today show the credentials hint that mentions the VPN.
acceptance_criteria: Given a hand-built report with a throwing getter or non-string code, When formatSmoke runs, Then it does not throw and prints `internal` for that field.
